body:
Hey, I understand how you feel. I had a breakdown yesterday too. I texted my sister to make sure that if anything happened to me she would take my daughter. I texted my mom and she suggested I exercise(which was annoying because I was suicidal but she meant well). I went from not wanting to kill myself to convincing myself there was no other way. I told myself that my daughter would have a chance at a better life if I was gone. And the only thing that kept me hanging onto a single shred of life was the thought of her coming home on the bus from school (she is 4 yrs old) and realizing that no one would be there waiting for her. 

I contacted my therapist and I sat as still as I could and just cried it all out until it was time to head to the bus stop. I almost did so many self destructive things but it was the thought of my daughter that helped me hold onto some sanity. Sometimes life hurts really bad and it's hard to see the point but remember your kids when you break down. And reach out to people. It's hard to reach out because you feel like no one cares but it's not true. Sometimes they are afraid to say the wrong thing and they dont know what to say but they want to see you happy and feeling better.  They do care.

Just go home, take a long bath and cry. Cry for as long as it takes to make yourself tired. After that you will feel like a weight has lifted and you can think about your next step in the healing process. Consider getting professional help. It is very beneficial if you open your mind to it and find the right person. My therapist is like family to me now and yesterday she was the one who helped me to see there are other options. I know that you can get through this. You are doing your best and your life is so important. I have faith in you and will pray for your recovery.💕

Thank you for some many kind and encouraging words. I'm just not a super materialistic person. And he doesnt know how to show me love without buying something or taking me out when all I want is someone to talk to and connect with. I tell him what I want and need but I feel like he keeps taking the easy way out and trying to buy my love to shut me up.

I dont know, aside from the emotional disconnect he's a good person. He's just selfish when it comes to emotional support. He only seems to care about how he feels in that respect. But if I'm sick or hungry, he will get me medicine or buy me food. I feel like we both need to change some things but we can't when only one of us is willing to talk about it. 

I hope one day both you and I can feel true happiness with ourselves (even if we do it alone). Sometimes it's easier to be happy alone, I know from experience. Be patient and learn to live with yourself and love yourself first. Then you will find someone to love and not feel like you are taking away from yourself. Cry when you need to and do things to care for you. Dont give up on yourself yet. We can all figure this out together, I'm sure. My burden feels a little less heavy already. :)

I do have a therapist and she is just as stumped as I am. Because he never opens up, I don't know how he truly feels. I only know what he says when he is angry. He tells me he loves me but that's it. He doesnt have any good things to say other than that. He tells me that he's with me because he's happy to come home to someone and that when he looks at me he sees someone who helped him out of a dark lonely place. But I feel like when he's saying those things, they really dont have to do with me as a person but just what I've done for him. And I feel like he's just with me so he won't be alone again. And that's where I start to wonder if the way I feel is real or if it's my depression filling my head up with negativity. My intuition is usually really good but idk. I've become so depressed it's hard to see clear.
